blocks.text: Bu darsdagi to'rt so'z vaqt **oralig'i** va **davomiyligi** haqida gapiradi. O'zbek tilida buni qo'shimchalar bilan aytamiz: soat to'qqiz**dan** besh**gacha**, kechqurun**gacha**, 2015-yil**dan beri**, uch yil (davomida). Ingliz tilida har bir ma'noga alohida predlog bor va u, odatdagidek, so'zdan **oldin** keladi: **from** nine **to** five, **until** evening, **since** 2015, **for** three years. Eng ko'p chalkashlik **since** va **for** orasida bo'ladi, chunki o'zbekchada ikkalasi ham ko'pincha «... dan beri» deb tarjima qilinadi.

**from** boshlanish nuqtasini, **to** tugash nuqtasini ko'rsatadi: **from** Monday **to** Friday — dushanba**dan** juma**gacha**. **to** o'rnida **until** yoki so'zlashuvdagi **till** ham ishlatiladi: **from** ten **until** six, **from** ten **till** six — ma'no bir xil. Ish vaqti, jadval, dars, ta'til haqida gapirganda bu juda qulay qolip.

items.text: The pool is open **from** 7 a.m. **to** 10 p.m.
We were in Bukhara **from** Friday **until** Sunday.

blocks.text: **until** harakat qaysi nuqtagacha davom etishini aytadi; shu nuqtada u to'xtaydi: I'll wait **until** six — oltigacha kutaman, keyin ketaman. **till** — xuddi shu so'z, faqat so'zlashuvda ko'proq. **until** dan keyin vaqt (until Monday) yoki butun gap kelishi mumkin: **until** it stops raining — yomg'ir to'xta**guncha**. Diqqat: kelajak haqida gapirsak ham, **until** dan keyingi gapda **will** ishlatilmaydi, Present Simple yetarli: until he **comes** («until he will come» emas). Inkor gapda **not ... until** «faqat ... da» degan ma'noni beradi: I didn't sleep **until** two — soat ikkigacha uxlamadim (ya'ni faqat ikkida uxladim).

items.text: The café is open **till** late on Fridays.
Please stay here **until** the doctor comes.
items.translation: Iltimos, shifokor kel**guncha** shu yerda turing.

items.text: We didn't have dinner **until** nine o'clock.

blocks.text: **since** — o'tmishdagi **boshlanish nuqtasi**: harakat o'sha paytda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etyapti. Undan keyin aniq vaqt keladi: **since** Monday, **since** 8 o'clock, **since** 2019, **since** I was a child. **for** — **davomiylik**, ya'ni vaqt o'lchovi: **for** two hours, **for** three days, **for** ten years, **for** ages. Oddiy savol yordam beradi: «**Qachondan beri?**» → **since**; «**Qancha vaqt?**» → **for**.

**since** deyarli doim Present Perfect (hozirgi tugallangan zamon) bilan keladi: I'**ve lived** here **since** 2019. O'zbekchada esa hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi: «2019-yildan beri shu yerda **yashayman**» — shuning uchun «I live here since 2019» degan xato juda ko'p uchraydi (batafsil — 19-dars). **for** esa har qanday zamon bilan ishlatiladi: I lived there **for** two years (o'tmishda, tugagan), I've lived here **for** two years (hali davom etyapti), I'm staying **for** a week (kelajak).

items.text: Kamola has been a doctor **for** fourteen years.
items.translation: Kamola o'n to'rt yil**dan beri** shifokor.

items.text: Before that, she studied in Tashkent **for** six years.
items.translation: Undan oldin u Toshkentda **olti yil** o'qigan.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I live here since 2015.» → **I've lived here since 2015.** (since — Present Perfect bilan); «since three years» → **for three years** (davr — for); «for 2015» → **since 2015** (nuqta — since); «I'll wait until he will come.» → **I'll wait until he comes.**; «I study English during three years.» → **for three years** (during — 105-dars).
Taqvim yoki soatda **barmoq bilan ko'rsatish** mumkin bo'lsa (2019, Monday, 8 o'clock) — **since**. **Chizg'ich bilan o'lchanadigan** bo'lsa (ikki soat, uch kun, besh yil) — **for**.

«How long ...?» (qancha vaqt? qachondan beri?) savoliga uch xil javob berish mumkin: davr bilan (**For** two weeks.), boshlanish bilan (**Since** June.) yoki tugash bilan (**Until** Sunday.). How long have you ...? savollari 18-darsda batafsil o'tilgan.

items.text: How long are you here? — **Until** Saturday.
How long have they been married? — **For** about a year.
items.translation: Ular turmush qurganiga qancha bo'ldi? — Bir yilcha **bo'ldi**.

blocks.text: Bog'lanish: for / since / ago — 19-dars; How long have you ...? — 18-dars; at / on / in (vaqt) — 103-dars; before, after, during, while — 105-dars.

examples.title: **from** ... **to**: start and end
examples.description: Boshlanish va tugash nuqtasi — **from ... to** (yoki **from ... until / till**): from nine to five — to'qqiz**dan** besh**gacha**.

sentences.text: The library is open **from** 9 a.m. **to** 8 p.m.
sentences.translation: Kutubxona ertalab 9**dan** kechki 8**gacha** ochiq.

sentences.text: I work **from** Monday **to** Friday, so I'm free at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dushanba**dan** juma**gacha** ishlayman, shuning uchun dam olish kunlari bo'shman.

sentences.text: **From** June **to** August the old city is full of tourists.
sentences.translation: Iyun**dan** avgust**gacha** eski shahar sayyohlarga to'la bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Our English class lasts **from** ten **to** half past eleven.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili darsimiz soat o'n**dan** o'n bir yarim**gacha** davom etadi.

sentences.text: Madina lived in Oxford **from** 2018 **to** 2021.
sentences.translation: Madina 2018**dan** 2021-yil**gacha** Oksfordda yashagan.

sentences.text: The road will be closed **from** Tuesday **until** Thursday.
sentences.translation: Yo'l seshanba**dan** payshanba**gacha** yopiq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Is the zoo open **from** ten **till** six every day?
sentences.translation: Hayvonot bog'i har kuni o'n**dan** olti**gacha** ochiqmi?

sentences.text: Shops in our street are open **from** early morning **to** late at night.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi do'konlar erta tong**dan** kech tun**gacha** ochiq.

sentences.text: My grandfather was a teacher **from** 1975 **to** 2015 — forty years!
sentences.translation: Bobom 1975**dan** 2015-yil**gacha** o'qituvchi bo'lgan — qirq yil!

sentences.text: The summer holidays at our school last **from** the end of May **to** the beginning of September.
sentences.translation: Maktabimizda yozgi ta'til may oxiri**dan** sentabr boshi**gacha** davom etadi.

examples.title: **until** / **till** + time: until Friday
examples.description: **until** (so'zlashuvda **till**) — «... gacha»: harakat shu vaqtgacha davom etadi, keyin to'xtaydi. Inkorda — «faqat ... da»: didn't go **until** two.

sentences.text: Let's wait **until** Monday and then decide.
sentences.translation: Dushanba**gacha** kutib, keyin hal qilaylik.

sentences.text: I stayed in bed **until** ten o'clock this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab soat o'n**gacha** to'shakda yotdim.

sentences.text: The bakery is open **till** eight tonight.
sentences.translation: Novvoyxona bugun kechqurun sakkiz**gacha** ochiq.

sentences.text: Bekzod is on holiday **until** the end of the month.
sentences.translation: Bekzod oy oxiri**gacha** ta'tilda.

sentences.text: We talked **until** midnight and then went to sleep.
sentences.translation: Yarim tun**gacha** gaplashib, keyin uxlagani yotdik.

sentences.text: Can I keep this book **until** next week?
sentences.translation: Bu kitobni kelasi hafta**gacha** olib tursam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Sarah didn't go to bed **until** two in the morning.
sentences.translation: Sara tungi soat ikki**gacha** uxlagani yotmadi.

sentences.text: The new bridge won't be ready **until** 2028.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik 2028-yil**gacha** tayyor bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: **Until** last year my parents lived in a village near Samarkand.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yil**gacha** ota-onam Samarqand yaqinidagi qishloqda yashagan.

sentences.text: You can park here **until** six, but after that it's not allowed.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda soat olti**gacha** mashina qo'ysangiz bo'ladi, undan keyin esa mumkin emas.

examples.title: **until** + clause: until it stops raining
examples.description: **until** dan keyin butun gap ham keladi — o'zbekchada «-guncha». Kelajak haqida bo'lsa ham bu gapda **Present Simple**: until he **comes** («until he will come» emas).

sentences.text: Wait here **until** I come back.
sentences.translation: Men qaytib kel**gunimcha** shu yerda kuting.

sentences.text: Let's stay inside **until** it stops raining.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir to'xta**guncha** ichkarida qolaylik.

sentences.text: Don't open your eyes **until** I say "now".
sentences.translation: Men «hozir» de**gunimcha** ko'zingizni ochmang.

sentences.text: Aziz will live with his parents **until** he finds a job.
sentences.translation: Aziz ish top**guncha** ota-onasi bilan yashaydi.

sentences.text: Keep stirring the soup **until** it boils.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva qayna**guncha** aralashtirib turing.

sentences.text: We didn't know about the problem **until** the manager told us.
sentences.translation: Menejer ayt**maguncha** biz muammo haqida bilmasdik.

sentences.text: The baby cried **until** her mother picked her up.
sentences.translation: Onasi ko'tarib ol**guncha** chaqaloq yig'ladi.

sentences.text: I'm not going to leave **until** I get an answer.
sentences.translation: Javob ol**magunimcha** ketmayman.

sentences.text: Emma practised every day **until** she could play the whole piece.
sentences.translation: Emma butun asarni chala ol**guncha** har kuni mashq qildi.

sentences.text: Please don't phone me **until** the meeting finishes — I'll call you.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish tuga**guncha** menga qo'ng'iroq qilmang — o'zim qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

examples.title: **since** + starting point: since 2015
examples.description: **since** — «... dan beri»: o'tmishdagi boshlanish nuqtasi (since Monday, since 8 o'clock, since I was a child). Odatda Present Perfect bilan.

sentences.text: I've known Dilnoza **since** 2015.
sentences.translation: Dilnozani 2015-yil**dan beri** taniyman.

sentences.text: It's been raining **since** this morning.
sentences.translation: Ertalab**dan beri** yomg'ir yog'yapti.

sentences.text: We've lived in this flat **since** our son was born.
sentences.translation: O'g'limiz tug'ilgan**idan beri** shu kvartirada yashaymiz.

sentences.text: Tom has worked at the bank **since** January.
sentences.translation: Tom yanvar**dan beri** bankda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: I haven't eaten anything **since** breakfast.
sentences.translation: Nonushta**dan beri** hech narsa yemadim.

sentences.text: Madina has been learning English **since** she was eight.
sentences.translation: Madina sakkiz yoshi**dan beri** ingliz tilini o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: **Since** Monday the weather has been cold and windy.
sentences.translation: Dushanba**dan beri** havo sovuq va shamolli.

sentences.text: How long have you been waiting? — **Since** half past two!
sentences.translation: Qachondan beri kutyapsiz? — Ikki yarim**dan beri**!

sentences.text: The café has been closed **since** the owner moved to London.
sentences.translation: Egasi Londonga ko'chib ketgan**idan beri** kafe yopiq.

sentences.text: My grandparents have been married **since** 1970, and they're still very happy.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim 1970-yil**dan beri** er-xotin va hali ham juda baxtli.

examples.title: **for** + period: for three years
examples.description: **for** — davomiylik (qancha vaqt): for two hours, for a week, for ages. Har qanday zamonda ishlatiladi. O'zbekchada ko'pincha qo'shimchasiz, «-ga» yoki «... dan beri».

sentences.text: I slept **for** nine hours last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha **to'qqiz soat** uxladim.

sentences.text: We're going to Samarkand **for** a week.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga bir hafta**ga** boryapmiz.

sentences.text: Aziz lived in London **for** three years and then came home.
sentences.translation: Aziz Londonda **uch yil** yashab, keyin uyga qaytdi.

sentences.text: Boil the eggs **for** ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Tuxumlarni **o'n daqiqa** qaynating.

sentences.text: I've had this phone **for** two years, and it still works well.
sentences.translation: Bu telefon menda ikki yil**dan beri** bor va hali ham yaxshi ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The patient has been in hospital **for** a month.
sentences.translation: Bemor bir oy**dan beri** kasalxonada.

sentences.text: Can you look after my cat **for** a few days?
sentences.translation: **Bir necha kun** mushugimga qarab tura olasizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah and James waited at the station **for** over an hour.
sentences.translation: Sara bilan Jeyms bekatda bir soat**dan ortiq** kutishdi.

sentences.text: We haven't seen each other **for** ages!
sentences.translation: Ko'rishmaganimizga **ancha bo'ldi**!

sentences.text: My uncle worked as a taxi driver **for** twenty years before he opened his own shop.
sentences.translation: Amakim o'z do'konini ochishdan oldin **yigirma yil** taksi haydovchisi bo'lib ishlagan.

examples.title: **since** or **for**? — a point or a period
examples.description: **since** + qachondan (nuqta): since 2019, since Monday. **for** + qancha vaqt (davr): for six years, for four days. Bir vaziyatni ikki xil aytish mumkin.

sentences.text: Bekzod has been ill **since** Monday.
sentences.translation: Bekzod dushanba**dan beri** kasal.

sentences.text: That means he's been ill **for** four days.
sentences.translation: Demak, u to'rt kun**dan beri** kasal.

sentences.text: We've had our car **since** 2019.
sentences.translation: Mashinamiz bizda 2019-yil**dan beri** bor.

sentences.text: Our neighbours have had their dog **for** about six years.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz itini olti yilcha**dan beri** boqishadi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has worked as a nurse **for** a long time — **since** she left college.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ancha vaqt**dan beri** — kollejni bitirgan**idan beri** hamshira bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Have you lived here **for** long? — No, only **since** March.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda anchadan beri yashaysizmi? — Yo'q, faqat mart**dan beri**.

sentences.text: Nobody has used this room **for** months.
sentences.translation: Bu xonadan bir necha oy**dan beri** hech kim foydalanmagan.

sentences.text: It hasn't rained **for** three weeks, and the garden is very dry.
sentences.translation: Uch hafta**dan beri** yomg'ir yog'madi, bog' juda qurib qoldi.

sentences.text: Mr Smith has taught at our school **for** twenty years, **since** 2006.
sentences.translation: Janob Smit maktabimizda 2006-yil**dan beri**, ya'ni yigirma yil**dan beri** dars beradi.

sentences.text: I haven't heard from Emma **since** her wedding, so I'm going to call her.
sentences.translation: Emmaning to'yi**dan beri** undan xabar yo'q, shuning uchun unga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchiman.

examples.title: How long ...? — **For** ... / **Since** ... / **Until** ...
examples.description: «How long ...?» savoliga javob: **for** + davr, **since** + boshlanish nuqtasi, **until** + tugash nuqtasi.

sentences.text: How long are you staying in London? — **For** ten days.
sentences.translation: Londonda qancha qolasiz? — O'n kun**ga** keldim.

sentences.text: How long have you known each other? — **Since** school.
sentences.translation: Bir-biringizni qachondan beri taniysiz? — Maktab**dan beri**.

sentences.text: Is the shop closed for long? — No, only **until** Monday morning.
sentences.translation: Do'kon uzoq vaqtga yopildimi? — Yo'q, faqat dushanba ertalab**gacha**.

sentences.text: Are you here on holiday? — Yes, **until** the end of August.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga dam olishga keldingizmi? — Ha, avgust oxiri**gacha**.

sentences.text: Is Tom still working at the hospital? — Yes, he's been there **for** six years now.
sentences.translation: Tom hali ham shifoxonada ishlaydimi? — Ha, u yerda olti yil**dan beri** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Have you studied English for a long time? — Yes, **since** I was twelve.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini anchadan beri o'rganasizmi? — Ha, o'n ikki yoshim**dan beri**.

sentences.text: Was it a long flight? — Yes, we were in the air **for** seven hours.
sentences.translation: Parvoz uzoq bo'ldimi? — Ha, havoda **yetti soat** bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Can I borrow your bike? — Sure, **until** Sunday — I need it on Monday.
sentences.translation: Velosipedingizni olib tursam bo'ladimi? — Albatta, yakshanba**gacha** — dushanba kuni o'zimga kerak.

sentences.text: Has Dilnoza been waiting long? — Yes, **since** half past four, poor thing.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ko'pdan beri kutyaptimi? — Ha, to'rt yarim**dan beri**, bechora.

sentences.text: Are the mountain roads still closed? — Yes, and they'll stay closed **until** the snow stops.
sentences.translation: Tog' yo'llari hali ham yopiqmi? — Ha, qor to'xta**guncha** yopiq turadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a summer in London
examples.description: Suhbat: **from ... to**, **until**, **since** va **for** bitta vaziyatda — Aziz yozda Londonda ishlayapti, Emma u bilan uchrashmoqchi.

sentences.text: — Hi Aziz! Are you in London **for** the whole summer?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Aziz! Londonga butun yoz**ga** keldingmi?

sentences.text: — Not quite. I'm here **from** the tenth of June **until** the end of August.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Bu yerda 10-iyun**dan** avgust oxiri**gacha** bo'laman.

sentences.text: — And what do you do all day? Have you got a job **for** the summer?
sentences.translation: — Kun bo'yi nima qilasan? Yoz**ga** ish topdingmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, I've worked at a café near the river **since** my second week here.
sentences.translation: — Ha, bu yerdagi ikkinchi haftam**dan beri** daryo bo'yidagi kafeda ishlayapman.

sentences.text: — Do you work there **from** morning **till** night?
sentences.translation: — U yerda ertalab**dan** kech**gacha** ishlaysanmi?

sentences.text: — No, only **from** eight **to** two, so my afternoons are free.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, faqat sakkiz**dan** ikki**gacha**, shuning uchun tushdan keyin bo'shman.

sentences.text: — Great, because I'm only in town **for** a week — **until** Sunday.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r, chunki men shaharda faqat bir hafta**ga** — yakshanba**gacha** bo'laman.

sentences.text: — Then let's meet on Friday. I'm free **from** two **until** late evening.
sentences.translation: — Unda juma kuni uchrashaylik. Soat ikki**dan** kech kech**gacha** bo'shman.

sentences.text: — Perfect! I haven't seen you **for** almost a year!
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Seni ko'rmaganimga deyarli bir yil **bo'ldi**!

sentences.text: — I know! Not **since** your sister's wedding in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman! Opangning Toshkentdagi to'yi**dan beri** ko'rishmadik.
